Thanks again for the call earlier "; really appreciate you walking us through your deployment and compliance priorities. Quick recap and next steps from our side:

Proposed next steps:
1) Aditya to confirm SOC 2 availability and what we can share today (by EOD Thu).
2) Vivek to provide a brief data-flow mapping and which subprocessors have access to plaintext (by Fri).
3) Samir/Helen to confirm whether Acme requires a vendor security questionnaire (VSQ) initiated in the next week and whether procurement needs a PO.

Hi team,

Quick security answers to move this forward: 

1) SOC 2 Type II: We completed a SOC 2 Type II for the period ending Dec 31, 2025. We can share the full report via our secure portal once a mutual NDA is in place; alternatively we can provide a time-limited secure download link and redacted sections if needed. Marissa - I can start the portal share process today.

2) Subprocessors & data access: Current primary subprocessors (high level):
   - Cloud compute: Google Cloud (us-central1, europe-west1) - stores encrypted customer artifacts; only compute instances in region have ephemeral access to plaintext during inference.
   - Object storage: GCS (same regions) - encrypted at rest, customer artifacts are scoped per-account.
   - Observability: Datadog - traces/metrics aggregated; we redact payloads and do not send full request bodies to observability by default.
   - Logging/backup: S3 (multi-region replication for resilience) - backups encrypted and access-controlled.
   - Payments: Stripe - billing metadata only, no customer inference data.

3) EU cross-border transfers: By default we route EU customer data to europe-west1. We do not replicate EU customers' inference data to the US unless the customer enables cross-region replication. If Acme requires a data processing addendum with EU SCCs, we can provide those.

4) VSQ initiation: We support OneTrust/SharedSecurity portals and can complete a standard vendor questionnaire. Vivek - can you provide the data-flow diagram and list of endpoints that would be relevant to the VSQ?

Happy to jump on a short call if Acme wants to walk through the portal.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Information Security Manager | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com
